exposure: endogenous sex steroid levels (estradiol, SHBG, androstendion, DHEAS, testosterone)
outcome: pelvic floor questionnaire scores (prolapse domain score, sex domain score)
cohort: A total of 93 postmenopausal women with pelvic floor disorders, consisting of 46 women with pelvic organ prolapse (POP) and 47 with stress urinary incontinence (SUI).
finding: In postmenopausal women with POP, high serum SHBG was independently associated with worse scores in the prolapse domain, and low serum DHEAS was a significant predictor for worse scores in the sex domain, with no associations found in SUI cases.
cross-section timing: The study was performed in postmenopausal women.
